final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e."aCL IgG") AS avg_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS A FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(A) AS B FROM sex_averages) SELECT s.sex, s.avg_igg, s.A, s.A / o.B AS A_div_B FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.B IS NOT NULL
